pairs: Misit quoque Hiram rex Tyri nuntios ad David,
Also, Hiram, the king of Tyre,
and cedar wood, and artisans of walls and of wood,
so that they might build a house for him.
Cognovitque David quod confirmasset eum Dominus in regem super Israël,
And David realized that the Lord had confirmed him as king over Israel,
et sublevatum esset regnum suum super populum ejus Israël.
and that his kingdom had been lifted up over his people Israel.
Accepit quoque David alias uxores in Jerusalem,
David took other wives in Jerusalem.
And he conceived sons and daughters.
Et hæc nomina eorum, qui nati sunt ei in Jerusalem:
And these are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem:
Audientes autem Philisthiim eo quod unctus esset David regem super universum Israël,
Then, hearing that David had been anointed as king over all of Israel,
all the Philistines ascended so that they might seek him.
But when David had heard of it,
he went out to meet them.
spread out in the Valley of the Rephaim.
And so David consulted the Lord,
et si trades eos in manu mea?
and will you deliver them into my hand?”
And the Lord said to him,
et tradam eos in manu tua.
and I will deliver them into your hand.”
And when they had ascended to Baal-perazim,
Divisit Deus inimicos meos per manum meam,
“God has divided my enemies by my hand,
et idcirco vocatum est nomen illius loci Baalpharasim.
And therefore the name of that place was called Baal-perazim.
And they left behind their gods in that place,
and so David ordered them to be burned.
And then, at another time, the Philistines invaded,
and they spread out in the valley.
et venies contra illos ex adverso pyrorum.
And you shall come against them opposite the balsam trees.
Cumque audieris sonitum gradientis in cacumine pyrorum,
And when you hear a sound approaching in the tops of the balsam trees,
then you shall go forth to war.
egressus est enim Deus ante te,
For God has gone forth before you,
so that he may strike down the army of the Philistines.”
Fecit ergo David sicut præceperat ei Deus,
Therefore, David did just as God had instructed him.
And he struck down the army of the Philistines,
from Gibeon as far as Gazera.
Divulgatumque est nomen David in universis regionibus,
And the name of David became well-known in all the regions.
et Dominus dedit pavorem ejus super omnes gentes.
And the Lord placed the fear of him over all the nations.
